lastResponse.text: First step: pause with me and take one slow breath in, then out. If you are in immediate danger right now, call nine one one now. If you’re safe, I can stay with you and do this one step at a time. Tell me the one thing you need most right now.
originalTexts: First step: pause with me and take one slow breath in, then out. If you are in immediate danger right now, call 911 now. If you’re safe, I can stay with you and do this one step at a time. Tell me the one thing you need most right now.
slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: Hi, sorry, I am talking fast, I know, I just got off two buses and my brain is scrambled right now.
